speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to help me determine the cause, how many days old were you when these symptoms started, and were you born prematurely?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hyaline Membrane Disease (Respiratory Distress Syndrome). The combination of prematurity (33 weeks) and onset of respiratory distress within 2 hours of birth is classic for this condition. Please proceed with a Chest_X-Ray to confirm the ground-glass appearance and request a STAT Blood Gas analysis to assess oxygenation status.
